definitions.gloss: to join; to become a member; to enroll
definitions.explanation: To officially join an organization, club, association, or membership-based service.

examples.japanese: テニス{部|ぶ}に{入会|にゅうかい}した。
{入会|にゅうかい}するには{申込書|もうしこみしょ}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: An application form is required to join.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}に{勧|すす}められて、スポーツジムに{入会|にゅうかい}することにした。
examples.english: My friend recommended it, so I decided to join a sports gym.

notes:
Composed of {入|にゅう} (enter) + {会|かい} (association, group). Used for formally joining organizations with membership structures — clubs, gyms, associations, unions, and online services.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入会|にゅうかい}{金|きん} — enrollment fee, membership fee
- {入会|にゅうかい}{申|もう}し{込|こ}み — membership application
- {入会|にゅうかい}{資格|しかく} — membership qualifications
- {入会|にゅうかい}{手続|てつづ}き — enrollment procedures
- {入会|にゅうかい}を{申|もう}し{込|こ}む — to apply for membership

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {加入|かにゅう}する — to join, to subscribe; often used for insurance, unions, and larger organizations
- {入部|にゅうぶ}する — to join a club (specifically school clubs)
- {参加|さんか}する — to participate; does not imply formal membership

ANTONYM:
- {退会|たいかい}する — to withdraw from, to cancel membership
